## Redirect to URI with encrypted API key

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X GET http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/applications/auth-redirect \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`GET /api/v2/applications/auth-redirect`

Redirects to `redirect_uri` with an encrypted API key added to the query, which lets a subdomain workspace app sign you in.
The key can only connect to workspace apps, and it expires when your session does or after the default session duration, whichever comes first.
Redirects you to the login page when you aren't signed in.

### Parameters

| Name           | In    | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                              |
|----------------|-------|--------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `redirect_uri` | query | string | false    | URL to redirect to. The route returns `400` without it, and the URL must be the primary wildcard app hostname, a workspace proxy access URL, or a workspace proxy wildcard app hostname. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                                 | Description        | Schema |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|--------|
| 307    | [Temporary Redirect](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.4.7) | Temporary Redirect |        |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).

## Get applications host

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X GET http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/applications/host \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`GET /api/v2/applications/host`

Returns the wildcard hostname that Coder uses for subdomain workspace apps, or an empty `host` when the deployment doesn't set one.
Deprecated. Use `GET /api/v2/regions` and read the `wildcard_hostname` of the primary workspace proxy instead.

### Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "host": "string"
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                 | Description | Schema                                                         |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| 200    | [OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1) | OK          | [codersdk.AppHostResponse](schemas.md#codersdkapphostresponse) |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).
